issues.issue: Was Charkaoui's procedural fairness breached by belated disclosure of an interview summary and destruction of CSIS notes, so that a stay of proceedings is warranted?
issues.applicant_position: Late disclosure and destruction of interview notes breach s.7 Charter fairness and warrant a stay of the inadmissibility proceedings.
issues.respondent_position: CSIS policy is justified by the strict-necessity test in s.12 CSIS Act; no prejudice from the missing notes has been shown.
issues.result_quote: Mr. Charkaoui is unable to demonstrate a breach of his right to procedural fairness that would entitle him to a stay

issues.issue: May the designated judge receive new allegations that the Ministers did not have when they signed the certificate?
issues.applicant_position: Review of the certificate should use only information the Ministers had when signing; the new allegations should be excluded and dismissed.
issues.result_quote: I am therefore of the opinion that Mr. Charkaoui’s submissions on this point must be rejected.
